name: Vancouver

neighborhoods.homes: older houses and small apartment buildings

housing: Vancouver's rentals are mostly apartment complexes and single-family houses, with new apartment buildings downtown and along the waterfront.

climate: Look for mold, damp and leaks, and check that bathroom fans work; the long rainy season keeps homes wet.
fact: Many Vancouver residents work in Portland, Oregon, but Washington's landlord-tenant law, not Oregon's, applies to Vancouver rentals.
